verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lacks first-party documentation explicitly describing Teams' channel-thread-reply UI (the docs items are almost all about bots/agents/Graph API, not the end-user threading feature), and the closest support is generic chatMessage API references. Meanwhile hands-on community feedback explicitly confirms the feature exists but criticizes its implementation ('the biggest issue was the threading; it truly beggars belief', and inconsistent threading between channels vs DMs), showing users find it confusing rather than seamless. missing for 10: dedicated docs on channel thread/reply UI, confirmation that replies visually nest under the original message, independent praise or benchmarking of thread usability.
